name: seenode
description: Deploy, troubleshoot, and manage static sites, web/worker/private applications, databases, storage, domains, projects, and billing on Seenode via the hosted Seenode MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy and manage apps on Seenode
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Seenode to deploy GitHub/GitLab apps including static sites, create and link MySQL/PostgreSQL databases, wait on deployments, inspect logs and metrics, manage environment variables and storage, attach custom domains, and check credits/billing. Authentication uses OAuth against the hosted Seenode MCP — no API keys in plugin config.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this repository to Seenode as a web app
Deploy this Vite SPA to Seenode as a static site
Create a PostgreSQL database and link it to my Seenode app
Why did my latest Seenode deployment fail?
What is my Seenode credit balance?
Add a custom domain to my Seenode web app and show DNS records
